verses.original: Ἦν δὲ τὸ πάσχα καὶ τὰ ἄζυμα μετὰ δύο ἡμέρας καὶ ἐζήτουν οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς πῶς αὐτὸν ἐν δόλῳ κρατήσαντες ἀποκτείνωσιν
verses.transliteration: Ēn de to pascha kai ta azyma meta dyo hēmeras kai ezētoun hoi archiereis kai hoi grammateis pōs auton en dolō kratēsantes apokteinōsin
verses.literal: Now the Passover and the Feast of Unleavened Bread were two days away and the chief priests and scribes were looking for a covert way to arrest Jesus and kill Him

verses.original: ἔλεγον γάρ Μὴ ἐν τῇ ἑορτῇ μή‿ ποτε ἔσται θόρυβος τοῦ λαοῦ
verses.transliteration: elegon gar Mē en tē heortē mē pote estai thorybos tou laou
verses.literal: But not during the feast they said or . . . there may be a riot among the people

verses.original: Καὶ ὄντος αὐτοῦ ἐν Βηθανίᾳ ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ Σίμωνος τοῦ λεπροῦ κατακειμένου αὐτοῦ ἦλθεν γυνὴ ἔχουσα ἀλάβαστρον μύρου νάρδου πιστικῆς πολυτελοῦς συντρίψασα τὴν ἀλάβαστρον κατέχεεν αὐτοῦ τῆς κεφαλῆς
verses.transliteration: Kai ontos autou en Bēthania en tē oikia Simōnos tou leprou katakeimenou autou ēlthen gynē echousa alabastron myrou nardou pistikēs polytelous syntripsasa tēn alabastron katecheen autou tēs kephalēs
verses.literal: While Jesus was in Bethany reclining at the table in the home of Simon the Leper a woman came with an alabaster jar of expensive perfume made of pure nard She broke open the jar and poured it on Jesus’ head

verses.original: Ἦσαν δέ τινες ἀγανακτοῦντες πρὸς ἑαυτούς Εἰς τί ἡ ἀπώλεια αὕτη τοῦ μύρου γέγονεν
verses.transliteration: Ēsan de tines aganaktountes pros heautous Eis ti hē apōleia hautē tou myrou gegonen
verses.literal: Some of those present however expressed their indignation to one another Why . . . this waste of perfume

verses.original: ἠδύνατο γὰρ τοῦτο τὸ μύρον πραθῆναι ἐπάνω δηναρίων τριακοσίων καὶ δοθῆναι τοῖς πτωχοῖς καὶ ἐνεβριμῶντο αὐτῇ
verses.transliteration: ēdynato gar touto to myron prathēnai epanō dēnariōn triakosiōn kai dothēnai tois ptōchois kai enebrimōnto autē
verses.literal: It could have been sold for over three hundred denarii and the money given to the poor And they scolded her

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν Ἄφετε αὐτήν τί αὐτῇ κόπους παρέχετε καλὸν ἔργον ἠργάσατο ἐν ἐμοί
verses.transliteration: Ho de Iēsous eipen Aphete autēn ti autē kopous parechete kalon ergon ērgasato en emoi
verses.literal: But Jesus said Leave her alone . . . why are you bothering . . . her She has done a beautiful deed to Me

verses.original: πάντοτε γὰρ τοὺς πτωχοὺς ἔχετε μεθ’ ἑαυτῶν καὶ ὅταν θέλητε δύνασθε αὐτοῖς εὖ ποιῆσαι ἐμὲ δὲ οὐ πάντοτε ἔχετε
verses.transliteration: pantote gar tous ptōchous echete meth’ heautōn kai hotan thelēte dynasthe autois eu poiēsai eme de ou pantote echete
verses.literal: The poor you will always have with you and you can help them whenever you want But you will not always have Me

verses.original: ὃ ἔσχεν ἐποίησεν προέλαβεν μυρίσαι τὸ σῶμά μου εἰς τὸν ἐνταφιασμόν
verses.transliteration: ho eschen epoiēsen proelaben myrisai to sōma mou eis ton entaphiasmon
verses.literal: She has done what she could to anoint My body in advance of My burial

verses.original: ἀμὴν δὲ λέγω ὑμῖν ὅπου ἐὰν κηρυχθῇ τὸ εὐαγγέλιον εἰς ὅλον τὸν κόσμον καὶ ὃ ἐποίησεν αὕτη λαληθήσεται εἰς μνημόσυνον αὐτῆς
verses.transliteration: amēn de legō hymin hopou ean kērychthē to euangelion eis holon ton kosmon kai ho epoiēsen hautē lalēthēsetai eis mnēmosynon autēs
verses.literal: And truly I tell you wherever . . . the gospel is preached in all the world what she has done will also be told in memory of her

verses.original: Καὶ Ἰούδας Ἰσκαριὼθ ὁ εἷς τῶν δώδεκα ἀπῆλθεν πρὸς τοὺς ἀρχιερεῖς ἵνα αὐτὸν παραδοῖ αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: Kai Ioudas Iskariōth ho heis tōn dōdeka apēlthen pros tous archiereis hina auton paradoi autois
verses.literal: Then Judas Iscariot one of the Twelve went to the chief priests to betray Jesus to them

verses.original: οἱ δὲ ἀκούσαντες ἐχάρησαν καὶ ἐπηγγείλαντο αὐτῷ ἀργύριον δοῦναι καὶ ἐζήτει πῶς αὐτὸν εὐκαίρως παραδοῖ
verses.transliteration: hoi de akousantes echarēsan kai epēngeilanto autō argyrion dounai kai ezētei pōs auton eukairōs paradoi
verses.literal: They were delighted - to hear this and they promised to give him money So Judas began to look for an opportunity to betray Jesus

verses.original: Καὶ τῇ πρώτῃ ἡμέρᾳ τῶν ἀζύμων ὅτε τὸ πάσχα ἔθυον λέγουσιν αὐτῷ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ Ποῦ θέλεις ἀπελθόντες ἑτοιμάσωμεν ἵνα φάγῃς τὸ πάσχα
verses.transliteration: Kai tē prōtē hēmera tōn azymōn hote to pascha ethyon legousin autō hoi mathētai autou Pou theleis apelthontes hetoimasōmen hina phagēs to pascha
verses.literal: On the first day of the Feast of Unleavened Bread when the Passover lamb was to be sacrificed Jesus’ disciples asked Him Where do You want us to prepare for You to eat the Passover

verses.original: Καὶ ἀποστέλλει δύο τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Ὑπάγετε εἰς τὴν πόλιν καὶ ἀπαντήσει ὑμῖν ἄνθρωπος κεράμιον ὕδατος βαστάζων ἀκολουθήσατε αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: Kai apostellei dyo tōn mathētōn autou kai legei autois Hypagete eis tēn polin kai apantēsei hymin anthrōpos keramion hydatos bastazōn akolouthēsate autō
verses.literal: So He sent two of His disciples and told them Go into the city and a man carrying a jug of water will meet you Follow him

verses.original: καὶ ὅπου ἐὰν εἰσέλθῃ εἴπατε τῷ οἰκοδεσπότῃ ὅτι Ὁ Διδάσκαλος λέγει Ποῦ ἐστιν τὸ κατάλυμά μου ὅπου τὸ πάσχα μετὰ τῶν μαθητῶν μου φάγω
verses.transliteration: kai hopou ean eiselthē eipate tō oikodespotē hoti HO Didaskalos legei Pou estin to katalyma mou hopou to pascha meta tōn mathētōn mou phagō
verses.literal: and whichever house he enters say to the owner The Teacher asks Where is My guest room where I may eat the Passover with My disciples

verses.original: καὶ αὐτὸς ὑμῖν δείξει ἀνάγαιον μέγα ἐστρωμένον ἕτοιμον καὶ ἐκεῖ ἑτοιμάσατε ἡμῖν
verses.transliteration: kai autos hymin deixei anagaion mega estrōmenon hetoimon kai ekei hetoimasate hēmin
verses.literal: And he will show you a large upper room furnished and ready Make preparations for us there

verses.original: Καὶ ἐξῆλθον οἱ μαθηταὶ καὶ ἦλθον εἰς τὴν πόλιν καὶ εὗρον καθὼς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς καὶ ἡτοίμασαν τὸ πάσχα
verses.transliteration: Kai exēlthon hoi mathētai kai ēlthon eis tēn polin kai heuron kathōs eipen autois kai hētoimasan to pascha
verses.literal: So the disciples left and went into the city where they found everything as Jesus had described . . . And they prepared the Passover

verses.original: Καὶ ὀψίας γενομένης ἔρχεται μετὰ τῶν δώδεκα
verses.transliteration: Kai opsias genomenēs erchetai meta tōn dōdeka
verses.literal: When evening came Jesus arrived with the Twelve

verses.original: Καὶ ἀνακειμένων αὐτῶν καὶ ἐσθιόντων ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι εἷς ἐξ ὑμῶν παραδώσει με ὁ ἐσθίων μετ’ ἐμοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai anakeimenōn autōn kai esthiontōn ho Iēsous eipen Amēn legō hymin hoti heis ex hymōn paradōsei me ho esthiōn met’ emou
verses.literal: And while they were reclining and eating Jesus said Truly I tell you one of you who is eating with Me will betray Me

verses.original: ἤρξαντο λυπεῖσθαι καὶ λέγειν αὐτῷ εἷς κατὰ εἷς Μήτι ἐγώ
verses.transliteration: Ērxanto lypeisthai kai legein autō heis kata heis Mēti egō
verses.literal: They began to be grieved and to ask Him one after another Surely not I

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Εἷς τῶν δώδεκα ὁ ἐμβαπτόμενος μετ’ ἐμοῦ εἰς τὸ τρύβλιον
verses.transliteration: Ho de eipen autois Heis tōn dōdeka ho embaptomenos met’ emou eis to tryblion
verses.literal: He answered . . . It is one of the Twelve the one who is dipping his hand into the bowl with Me

verses.original: ὅτι ὁ μὲν Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ὑπάγει καθὼς γέγραπται περὶ αὐτοῦ οὐαὶ δὲ τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ ἐκείνῳ δι’ οὗ ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου παραδίδοται καλὸν αὐτῷ εἰ οὐκ ἐγεννήθη ὁ ἄνθρωπος ἐκεῖνος
verses.transliteration: hoti ho men Huios tou anthrōpou hypagei kathōs gegraptai peri autou ouai de tō anthrōpō ekeinō di’ hou ho Huios tou anthrōpou paradidotai kalon autō ei ouk egennēthē ho anthrōpos ekeinos
verses.literal: The Son of Man will go just as it is written about Him but woe to that man by whom He . . . . . . . . . is betrayed It would be better for him if - he had not been born

verses.original: Καὶ ἐσθιόντων αὐτῶν λαβὼν ἄρτον εὐλογήσας ἔκλασεν καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς καὶ εἶπεν Λάβετε τοῦτό ἐστιν τὸ σῶμά μου
verses.transliteration: Kai esthiontōn autōn labōn arton eulogēsas eklasen kai edōken autois kai eipen Labete touto estin to sōma mou
verses.literal: While they were eating Jesus took bread spoke a blessing and broke it and gave it to the disciples saying Take it this is My body

verses.original: Καὶ λαβὼν ποτήριον εὐχαριστήσας ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς καὶ ἔπιον ἐξ αὐτοῦ πάντες
verses.transliteration: Kai labōn potērion eucharistēsas edōken autois kai epion ex autou pantes
verses.literal: Then He took the cup gave thanks and gave it to them and they all drank from it

verses.original: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Τοῦτό ἐστιν τὸ αἷμά μου τῆς διαθήκης τὸ ἐκχυννόμενον ὑπὲρ πολλῶν
verses.transliteration: kai eipen autois Touto estin to haima mou tēs diathēkēs to ekchynnomenon hyper pollōn
verses.literal: He said to them This is My blood of the covenant which is poured out for many

verses.original: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐκέτι οὐ μὴ πίω ἐκ τοῦ γενήματος τῆς ἀμπέλου ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ἐκείνης ὅταν αὐτὸ πίνω καινὸν ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: amēn legō hymin hoti ouketi ou mē piō ek tou genēmatos tēs ampelou heōs tēs hēmeras ekeinēs hotan auto pinō kainon en tē basileia tou Theou
verses.literal: Truly I tell you I will no longer drink . . . of the fruit of the vine until that day when I drink it anew in the kingdom of God

verses.original: Καὶ ὑμνήσαντες ἐξῆλθον εἰς τὸ ὄρος τῶν Ἐλαιῶν
verses.transliteration: Kai hymnēsantes exēlthon eis to oros tōn Elaiōn
verses.literal: And when they had sung a hymn they went out to the Mount of Olives

verses.original: Καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς ὅτι Πάντες σκανδαλισθήσεσθε ὅτι γέγραπται Πατάξω τὸν ποιμένα Καὶ τὰ πρόβατα διασκορπισθήσονται
verses.transliteration: Kai legei autois ho Iēsous hoti Pantes skandalisthēsesthe hoti gegraptai Pataxō ton poimena Kai ta probata diaskorpisthēsontai
verses.literal: Then Jesus said to them You will all fall away for it is written I will strike the Shepherd and the sheep will be scattered

verses.original: Ἀλλὰ μετὰ τὸ ἐγερθῆναί με προάξω ὑμᾶς εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν
verses.transliteration: Alla meta to egerthēnai me proaxō hymas eis tēn Galilaian
verses.literal: But after I have risen I will go ahead of you into Galilee

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Πέτρος ἔφη αὐτῷ Εἰ καὶ πάντες σκανδαλισθήσονται ἀλλ’ οὐκ ἐγώ
verses.transliteration: Ho de Petros ephē autō Ei kai pantes skandalisthēsontai all’ ouk egō
verses.literal: Peter declared . . . Even if all fall away I never will

verses.original: Καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἀμὴν λέγω σοι ὅτι σὺ σήμερον ταύτῃ τῇ νυκτὶ πρὶν ἢ δὶς ἀλέκτορα φωνῆσαι τρίς με ἀπαρνήσῃ
verses.transliteration: Kai legei autō ho Iēsous Amēn legō soi hoti sy sēmeron tautē tē nykti prin ē dis alektora phōnēsai tris me aparnēsē
verses.literal: Truly I tell you - Jesus replied this very night before the rooster crows twice you will deny Me three times

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ ἐκπερισσῶς ἐλάλει Ἐὰν δέῃ με συναποθανεῖν σοι οὐ μή σε ἀπαρνήσομαι ὡσαύτως δὲ καὶ πάντες ἔλεγον
verses.transliteration: Ho de ekperissōs elalei Ean deē me synapothanein soi ou mē se aparnēsomai hōsautōs de kai pantes elegon
verses.literal: But Peter kept insisting . . . Even if I have to . . . die with You I will never deny You And all the others said the same thing . . .

verses.original: Καὶ ἔρχονται εἰς χωρίον οὗ τὸ ὄνομα Γεθσημανί καὶ λέγει τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ Καθίσατε ὧδε ἕως προσεύξωμαι
verses.transliteration: Kai erchontai eis chōrion hou to onoma Gethsēmani kai legei tois mathētais autou Kathisate hōde heōs proseuxōmai
verses.literal: Then they came to a place called . . . Gethsemane and Jesus told His disciples Sit here while I pray

verses.original: καὶ παραλαμβάνει τὸν Πέτρον καὶ τὸν Ἰάκωβον καὶ τὸν Ἰωάννην μετ’ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἤρξατο ἐκθαμβεῖσθαι καὶ ἀδημονεῖν
verses.transliteration: kai paralambanei ton Petron kai ton Iakōbon kai ton Iōannēn met’ autou kai ērxato ekthambeisthai kai adēmonein
verses.literal: He took with Him Peter - James and John and began to be deeply troubled and distressed

verses.original: καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Περίλυπός ἐστιν ἡ ψυχή μου ἕως θανάτου μείνατε ὧδε καὶ γρηγορεῖτε
verses.transliteration: kai legei autois Perilypos estin hē psychē mou heōs thanatou meinate hōde kai grēgoreite
verses.literal: Then He said to them My soul is consumed with sorrow to the point of death Stay here and keep watch

verses.original: Καὶ προελθὼν μικρὸν ἔπιπτεν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ προσηύχετο ἵνα εἰ δυνατόν ἐστιν παρέλθῃ ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ ἡ ὥρα
verses.transliteration: Kai proelthōn mikron epipten epi tēs gēs kai prosēucheto hina ei dynaton estin parelthē ap’ autou hē hōra
verses.literal: Going a little farther . . . He fell to the ground and prayed that if it were possible the hour would pass from Him

verses.original: καὶ ἔλεγεν Ἀββᾶ ὁ Πατήρ πάντα δυνατά σοι παρένεγκε τὸ ποτήριον τοῦτο ἀπ’ ἐμοῦ ἀλλ’ οὐ τί ἐγὼ θέλω ἀλλὰ τί σύ
verses.transliteration: kai elegen Abba ho Patēr panta dynata soi parenenke to potērion touto ap’ emou all’ ou ti egō thelō alla ti sy
verses.literal: Abba Father He said all things are possible for You Take this cup from Me Yet not what I will but what You will

verses.original: Καὶ ἔρχεται καὶ εὑρίσκει αὐτοὺς καθεύδοντας καὶ λέγει τῷ Πέτρῳ Σίμων καθεύδεις οὐκ ἴσχυσας μίαν ὥραν γρηγορῆσαι
verses.transliteration: Kai erchetai kai heuriskei autous katheudontas kai legei tō Petrō Simōn katheudeis ouk ischysas mian hōran grēgorēsai
verses.literal: Then Jesus returned and found them sleeping Simon are you asleep He asked - Were you not able to keep watch for one hour

verses.original: γρηγορεῖτε καὶ προσεύχεσθε ἵνα μὴ ἔλθητε εἰς πειρασμόν τὸ μὲν πνεῦμα πρόθυμον ἡ δὲ σὰρξ ἀσθενής
verses.transliteration: grēgoreite kai proseuchesthe hina mē elthēte eis peirasmon to men pneuma prothymon hē de sarx asthenēs
verses.literal: Watch and pray so that you will not enter into temptation For the spirit is willing but the body is weak

verses.original: Καὶ πάλιν ἀπελθὼν προσηύξατο τὸν αὐτὸν λόγον εἰπών
verses.transliteration: Kai palin apelthōn prosēuxato ton auton logon eipōn
verses.literal: Again He went away and prayed saying the same thing

verses.original: καὶ πάλιν ἐλθὼν εὗρεν αὐτοὺς καθεύδοντας ἦσαν γὰρ αὐτῶν οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ καταβαρυνόμενοι καὶ οὐκ ᾔδεισαν τί ἀποκριθῶσιν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: kai palin elthōn heuren autous katheudontas ēsan gar autōn hoi ophthalmoi katabarynomenoi kai ouk ēdeisan ti apokrithōsin autō
verses.literal: And again Jesus returned and found them sleeping for their eyes were heavy And they did not know what to answer Him

verses.original: Καὶ ἔρχεται τὸ τρίτον καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Καθεύδετε τὸ λοιπὸν καὶ ἀναπαύεσθε ἀπέχει ἦλθεν ἡ ὥρα ἰδοὺ παραδίδοται ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου εἰς τὰς χεῖρας τῶν ἁμαρτωλῶν
verses.transliteration: Kai erchetai to triton kai legei autois Katheudete to loipon kai anapauesthe apechei ēlthen hē hōra idou paradidotai ho Huios tou anthrōpou eis tas cheiras tōn hamartōlōn
verses.literal: When Jesus returned the third time He said - Are you still sleeping and resting That is enough The hour has come Look the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners

verses.original: ἐγείρεσθε ἄγωμεν ἰδοὺ ὁ παραδιδούς με ἤγγικεν
verses.transliteration: egeiresthe agōmen idou ho paradidous me ēngiken
verses.literal: Rise let us go See My betrayer . . . is approaching

verses.original: Καὶ εὐθὺς ἔτι αὐτοῦ λαλοῦντος παραγίνεται ὁ Ἰούδας εἷς τῶν δώδεκα καὶ μετ’ αὐτοῦ ὄχλος μετὰ μαχαιρῶν καὶ ξύλων παρὰ τῶν ἀρχιερέων καὶ τῶν γραμματέων καὶ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων
verses.transliteration: Kai euthys eti autou lalountos paraginetai ho Ioudas heis tōn dōdeka kai met’ autou ochlos meta machairōn kai xylōn para tōn archiereōn kai tōn grammateōn kai tōn presbyterōn
verses.literal: While Jesus was still speaking Judas one of the Twelve arrived accompanied by a crowd armed with swords and clubs sent from the chief priests - scribes and elders

verses.original: Δεδώκει δὲ ὁ παραδιδοὺς αὐτὸν σύσσημον αὐτοῖς λέγων Ὃν ἂν φιλήσω αὐτός ἐστιν κρατήσατε αὐτὸν καὶ ἀπάγετε ἀσφαλῶς
verses.transliteration: Dedōkei de ho paradidous auton syssēmon autois legōn Hon an philēsō autos estin kratēsate auton kai apagete asphalōs
verses.literal: Now the betrayer . . . had arranged a signal with them The One . . . I kiss is the man arrest Him and lead Him away securely

verses.original: καὶ ἐλθὼν εὐθὺς προσελθὼν αὐτῷ λέγει Ῥαββί καὶ κατεφίλησεν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: kai elthōn euthys proselthōn autō legei Rhabbi kai katephilēsen auton
verses.literal: Going directly to Jesus he said Rabbi and kissed Him

verses.original: Οἱ δὲ ἐπέβαλαν τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῷ καὶ ἐκράτησαν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Hoi de epebalan tas cheiras autō kai ekratēsan auton
verses.literal: Then the men seized . . . . . . Jesus and arrested Him

verses.original: εἷς δέ τις τῶν παρεστηκότων σπασάμενος τὴν μάχαιραν ἔπαισεν τὸν δοῦλον τοῦ ἀρχιερέως καὶ ἀφεῖλεν αὐτοῦ τὸ ὠτάριον
verses.transliteration: heis de tis tōn parestēkotōn spasamenos tēn machairan epaisen ton doulon tou archiereōs kai apheilen autou to ōtarion
verses.literal: And one of the bystanders drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest cutting off his ear

verses.original: Καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ὡς ἐπὶ λῃστὴν ἐξήλθατε μετὰ μαχαιρῶν καὶ ξύλων συλλαβεῖν με
verses.transliteration: Kai apokritheis ho Iēsous eipen autois Hōs epi lēstēn exēlthate meta machairōn kai xylōn syllabein me
verses.literal: Jesus asked the crowd Have you come out with swords and clubs to arrest Me as you would an outlaw

verses.original: καθ’ ἡμέραν ἤμην πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ διδάσκων καὶ οὐκ ἐκρατήσατέ με ἀλλ’ ἵνα πληρωθῶσιν αἱ γραφαί
verses.transliteration: kath’ hēmeran ēmēn pros hymas en tō hierō didaskōn kai ouk ekratēsate me all’ hina plērōthōsin hai graphai
verses.literal: Every day I was with you teaching in the temple courts and you did not arrest Me But this has happened that the Scriptures would be fulfilled

verses.original: Καὶ ἀφέντες αὐτὸν ἔφυγον πάντες
verses.transliteration: Kai aphentes auton ephygon pantes
verses.literal: Then everyone deserted Him and fled

verses.original: Καὶ νεανίσκος τις συνηκολούθει αὐτῷ περιβεβλημένος σινδόνα ἐπὶ γυμνοῦ καὶ κρατοῦσιν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Kai neaniskos tis synēkolouthei autō peribeblēmenos sindona epi gymnou kai kratousin auton
verses.literal: One young man who had been following Jesus was wearing a linen cloth around his body They caught hold of him

verses.original: ὁ δὲ καταλιπὼν τὴν σινδόνα γυμνὸς ἔφυγεν
verses.transliteration: ho de katalipōn tēn sindona gymnos ephygen
verses.literal: but he pulled free of the linen cloth and ran away naked

verses.original: Καὶ ἀπήγαγον τὸν Ἰησοῦν πρὸς τὸν ἀρχιερέα καὶ συνέρχονται πάντες οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς
verses.transliteration: Kai apēgagon ton Iēsoun pros ton archierea kai synerchontai pantes hoi archiereis kai hoi presbyteroi kai hoi grammateis
verses.literal: They led Jesus away to the high priest and all the chief priests - elders and scribes assembled

verses.original: καὶ ὁ Πέτρος ἀπὸ μακρόθεν ἠκολούθησεν αὐτῷ ἕως ἔσω εἰς τὴν αὐλὴν τοῦ ἀρχιερέως καὶ ἦν συνκαθήμενος μετὰ τῶν ὑπηρετῶν καὶ θερμαινόμενος πρὸς τὸ φῶς
verses.transliteration: kai ho Petros apo makrothen ēkolouthēsen autō heōs esō eis tēn aulēn tou archiereōs kai ēn synkathēmenos meta tōn hypēretōn kai thermainomenos pros to phōs
verses.literal: Peter followed Him at a distance right into the courtyard of the high priest And he sat with the officers and warmed himself by the fire

verses.original: Οἱ δὲ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ ὅλον τὸ συνέδριον ἐζήτουν κατὰ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ μαρτυρίαν εἰς τὸ θανατῶσαι αὐτόν καὶ οὐχ ηὕρισκον
verses.transliteration: Hoi de archiereis kai holon to synedrion ezētoun kata tou Iēsou martyrian eis to thanatōsai auton kai ouch hēuriskon
verses.literal: Now the chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin were seeking testimony against Jesus to put Him to death . . . but they did not find any

verses.original: πολλοὶ γὰρ ἐψευδομαρτύρουν κατ’ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἴσαι αἱ μαρτυρίαι οὐκ ἦσαν
verses.transliteration: polloi gar epseudomartyroun kat’ autou kai isai hai martyriai ouk ēsan
verses.literal: For many bore false witness against Jesus but their testimony was inconsistent

verses.original: Καί τινες ἀναστάντες ἐψευδομαρτύρουν κατ’ αὐτοῦ λέγοντες
verses.transliteration: Kai tines anastantes epseudomartyroun kat’ autou legontes
verses.literal: Then some men stood up and testified falsely against Him

verses.original: Ὅτι Ἡμεῖς ἠκούσαμεν αὐτοῦ λέγοντος ὅτι Ἐγὼ καταλύσω τὸν ναὸν τοῦτον τὸν χειροποίητον καὶ διὰ τριῶν ἡμερῶν ἄλλον ἀχειροποίητον οἰκοδομήσω
verses.transliteration: Hoti Hēmeis ēkousamen autou legontos hoti Egō katalysō ton naon touton ton cheiropoiēton kai dia triōn hēmerōn allon acheiropoiēton oikodomēsō
verses.literal: We heard Him say I will destroy this man-made temple and in three days I will build another that is made without hands

verses.original: καὶ οὐδὲ οὕτως ἴση ἦν ἡ μαρτυρία αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: kai oude houtōs isē ēn hē martyria autōn
verses.literal: But even their testimony was inconsistent

verses.original: Καὶ ἀναστὰς ὁ ἀρχιερεὺς εἰς μέσον ἐπηρώτησεν τὸν Ἰησοῦν λέγων Οὐκ ἀποκρίνῃ οὐδέν τί οὗτοί σου καταμαρτυροῦσιν
verses.transliteration: Kai anastas ho archiereus eis meson epērōtēsen ton Iēsoun legōn Ouk apokrinē ouden ti houtoi sou katamartyrousin
verses.literal: So the high priest stood up before them and questioned Jesus Have You no answer . . . What are these men testifying against You

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ ἐσιώπα καὶ οὐκ ἀπεκρίνατο οὐδέν Πάλιν ὁ ἀρχιερεὺς ἐπηρώτα αὐτὸν καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ Σὺ εἶ ὁ Χριστὸς ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ Εὐλογητοῦ
verses.transliteration: Ho de esiōpa kai ouk apekrinato ouden Palin ho archiereus epērōta auton kai legei autō Sy ei ho Christos ho Huios tou Eulogētou
verses.literal: But Jesus remained silent and made no reply . . . Again the high priest questioned Him - Are You the Christ the Son of the Blessed One

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν Ἐγώ εἰμι καὶ ὄψεσθε τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐκ δεξιῶν καθήμενον τῆς δυνάμεως καὶ ἐρχόμενον μετὰ τῶν νεφελῶν τοῦ οὐρανοῦ
verses.transliteration: Ho de Iēsous eipen Egō eimi kai opsesthe ton Huion tou anthrōpou ek dexiōn kathēmenon tēs dynameōs kai erchomenon meta tōn nephelōn tou ouranou
verses.literal: I am - said Jesus and you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power and coming with the clouds of heaven

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ ἀρχιερεὺς διαρρήξας τοὺς χιτῶνας αὐτοῦ λέγει Τί ἔτι χρείαν ἔχομεν μαρτύρων
verses.transliteration: Ho de archiereus diarrēxas tous chitōnas autou legei Ti eti chreian echomen martyrōn
verses.literal: At this the high priest tore his clothes and declared Why do we need . . . any more witnesses

verses.original: ἠκούσατε τῆς βλασφημίας τί ὑμῖν φαίνεται Οἱ δὲ πάντες κατέκριναν αὐτὸν ἔνοχον εἶναι θανάτου
verses.transliteration: ēkousate tēs blasphēmias ti hymin phainetai Hoi de pantes katekrinan auton enochon einai thanatou
verses.literal: You have heard the blasphemy What is your verdict And they all condemned Him as deserving of death

verses.original: Καὶ ἤρξαντό τινες ἐμπτύειν αὐτῷ καὶ περικαλύπτειν αὐτοῦ τὸ πρόσωπον καὶ κολαφίζειν αὐτὸν καὶ λέγειν αὐτῷ Προφήτευσον καὶ οἱ ὑπηρέται ῥαπίσμασιν αὐτὸν ἔλαβον
verses.transliteration: Kai ērxanto tines emptyein autō kai perikalyptein autou to prosōpon kai kolaphizein auton kai legein autō Prophēteuson kai hoi hypēretai rhapismasin auton elabon
verses.literal: Then some of them began to spit on Him They blindfolded Him . . . . . . . . . struck Him with their fists . . . and said to Him Prophesy And the officers received Him with slaps in His face

verses.original: Καὶ ὄντος τοῦ Πέτρου κάτω ἐν τῇ αὐλῇ ἔρχεται μία τῶν παιδισκῶν τοῦ ἀρχιερέως
verses.transliteration: Kai ontos tou Petrou katō en tē aulē erchetai mia tōn paidiskōn tou archiereōs
verses.literal: While Peter was in the courtyard below one of the servant girls of the high priest came down

verses.original: καὶ ἰδοῦσα τὸν Πέτρον θερμαινόμενον ἐμβλέψασα αὐτῷ λέγει Καὶ σὺ μετὰ τοῦ Ναζαρηνοῦ ἦσθα τοῦ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai idousa ton Petron thermainomenon emblepsasa autō legei Kai sy meta tou Nazarēnou ēstha tou Iēsou
verses.literal: and saw him warming himself there She looked at Peter and said You also were with Jesus the Nazarene

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ ἠρνήσατο λέγων Οὔτε οἶδα οὔτε ἐπίσταμαι σὺ τί λέγεις καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἔξω εἰς τὸ προαύλιον καὶ ἀλέκτωρ ἐφώνησεν
verses.transliteration: Ho de ērnēsato legōn Oute oida oute epistamai sy ti legeis kai exēlthen exō eis to proaulion kai alektōr ephōnēsen
verses.literal: But he denied it I do not know or even understand what you are talking about he said Then he went out to the gateway and the rooster crowed

verses.original: Καὶ ἡ παιδίσκη ἰδοῦσα αὐτὸν ἤρξατο πάλιν λέγειν τοῖς παρεστῶσιν ὅτι Οὗτος ἐξ αὐτῶν ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: Kai hē paidiskē idousa auton ērxato palin legein tois parestōsin hoti Houtos ex autōn estin
verses.literal: There the servant girl saw him and again said to those standing nearby This man is one of them

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ πάλιν ἠρνεῖτο Καὶ μετὰ μικρὸν πάλιν οἱ παρεστῶτες ἔλεγον τῷ Πέτρῳ Ἀληθῶς ἐξ αὐτῶν εἶ καὶ γὰρ Γαλιλαῖος εἶ
verses.transliteration: Ho de palin ērneito Kai meta mikron palin hoi parestōtes elegon tō Petrō Alēthōs ex autōn ei kai gar Galilaios ei
verses.literal: But he denied it again After a little while those standing nearby said once more to Peter Surely you are one of them for you too are a Galilean

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ ἤρξατο ἀναθεματίζειν καὶ ὀμνύναι ὅτι Οὐκ οἶδα τὸν ἄνθρωπον τοῦτον ὃν λέγετε
verses.transliteration: Ho de ērxato anathematizein kai omnynai hoti Ouk oida ton anthrōpon touton hon legete
verses.literal: But he began to curse and swear I do not know this man of whom you speak

verses.original: καὶ εὐθὺς ἐκ δευτέρου ἀλέκτωρ ἐφώνησεν Καὶ ἀνεμνήσθη ὁ Πέτρος τὸ ῥῆμα ὡς εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ὅτι Πρὶν ἀλέκτορα δὶς φωνῆσαι τρίς με ἀπαρνήσῃ καὶ ἐπιβαλὼν ἔκλαιεν
verses.transliteration: kai euthys ek deuterou alektōr ephōnēsen Kai anemnēsthē ho Petros to rhēma hōs eipen autō ho Iēsous hoti Prin alektora dis phōnēsai tris me aparnēsē kai epibalōn eklaien
verses.literal: And immediately the rooster crowed a second time Then Peter remembered the word that Jesus had spoken to him Before the rooster crows twice you will deny Me three times And he broke down and wept
